title: 信息更正与最终确认
goal: 区分原安排、候选方案和最终确认，按更正范围保留有效信息。

points.label: 识别取消或更正的信息
选取最后确认的有效信息

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 听力课的内容、知识点与教学规格

body.p: 更正表达改变已有的某一项信息。听到更正，要记下被否定的内容、替代的内容和它所属的字段。答案是最后确认、仍然有效的信息，不一定是最后出现的词或数字。

body.box: Monday is unavailable. Tuesday is possible, but please book Wednesday. Wednesday is confirmed. → Wednesday

body.p: 原安排是此前的计划，候选安排只说明可能，确认句才落实选择。Actually, the hall has a kitchen. 只是补充一个事实。出现 actually，日期或价格不一定改变。

cards.title: 信息的有效状态
rows: 原安排
此前定下的安排。被改动后就不再是答案。
We originally arranged delivery for Monday.
候选安排
can、could 说明可行。没有人接受，就还没有决定。
Tuesday could work, or perhaps Wednesday.
最终确认
双方都接受的具体安排。没有改动的部分照旧保留。
Please use Wednesday. / Wednesday is confirmed.
局部更正
只替换被指出的字段，其他字段继续有效。
Change the date to Friday; the price stays at £20.
追加说明
后出现的内容可能属于别的字段，前面的信息仍然有效。
Collection is Friday. The office is closed on Sunday.

cards.title: 更正表达
rows: actually
A: Is delivery on Monday? B: Actually, it's Tuesday. Monday is the packing day.
否定对方问题里的说法。属于同一字段时才替换。
actually
A: The charge is £18. B: Actually, the invoice says £16. A: Yes, £16 is correct.
核实后的金额替代报错的金额。
rather
A: Send it to Green Hall, or rather, Green House. B: Green House, understood.
or rather 修正刚说出的名称。
rather
A: The fitting is on the sixth, or rather, the sixteenth. B: I've written the sixteenth.
后面的词修正前面的词。rather 也可以表示偏好。
instead
A: Shall I reserve the morning slot? B: Book the afternoon instead. A: Done.
替换先前的选择，再听对方是否落实。
instead
A: Is the parcel going by post? B: I'll collect it instead. A: I'll keep it here.
换了一种做法，原来的做法取消。
否定后补充
A: Is the balance £40? B: No, £40 is the deposit. The balance is £60.
否定的是 £40 的归属，数字本身没错。
否定后补充
A: The order is for Lane? B: Not Lane; it's for Lake. A: Lake, corrected.
只改名称，订单的其他信息不变。

body.box:
A: The rehearsal was booked for the tenth at £45, under the name Marsh.
B: Could it move to the twelfth?
A: The twelfth is unavailable. The thirteenth is possible.
B: Please use the thirteenth. Also, the name is March, not Marsh.
A: March, on the thirteenth, confirmed. The price is £45, or rather £42 with the discount.
B: £42 is fine.
A: The office closes on the fifteenth.

body.p: tenth 是原日期，twelfth 是被否定的候选，thirteenth 才是确认的日期。fifteenth 最后出现，但它是办公室关闭的日期，与排练无关。
March 更正了姓名。or rather 后的 £42 更正了价格，£42 is fine 表示接受。每项答案看各自的话轮，一次更正只改一个字段。

lines.text: Is the basket order for the ninth?
Actually, the ninth is the payment deadline. Collection is on the eleventh.

options: The ninth is the payment deadline, not collection.
The payment deadline is cancelled without a replacement.
The collection is moved to the payment deadline.
The payment and collection are confirmed for the same day.
items.why: the ninth is the payment deadline 说明九日是付款期限，不是领取日，即第一项。领取日是 eleventh。

lines.text: The route begins at West Park, or rather, West Gate.
West Gate. I'll change the meeting-point note.

options: West Park as the meeting point
West Gate as the meeting point
Both the park and the gate
items.why: or rather, West Gate 更正刚说出的 West Park，改动的是集合地点。

lines.text: Would a paper receipt be useful?
Send an email receipt instead. I don't need a paper copy.

items.why: I don't need a paper copy 明确排除纸质收据，instead 引出电子收据。

lines.text: Was the quoted price sixty pounds?
No, sixteen pounds for the repair. Sixty was the price of a replacement.

items.stem: What was wrong with the initial question?
options: It gave sixteen as the repair price.
It treated sixteen pounds as the replacement price.
It assigned the replacement price to the repair.
items.why: Sixty was the price of a replacement 说明初问将更换价格误作维修价格。

lines.text: I'd prefer a collection on Thursday.
Thursday is full. Friday or Saturday would be possible.
Friday, please.
Friday is confirmed. Saturday is our last working day.

items.stem: Which day remains valid for collection?
items.why: Friday is confirmed 明确安排；最后的 Saturday 属于营业说明。

lines.text: The delivery is for Mr Wade.
Is that Mr Wake?
Wade, with a D at the end.
Wade, confirmed.

items.why: Wade, confirmed 接受原姓氏；中途的 Wake 是核实中的错误候选。

lines.text: The original quote was twenty-seven pounds. With the discount, it's twenty-four.
Twenty-four is acceptable.
I'll confirm twenty-four. The discount offer ends on the twenty-seventh.

items.stem: Confirmed price: £___ . Write A NUMBER in digits.
items.why: I'll confirm twenty-four 确认价格，最后的 twenty-seventh 是期限。

lines.text: I could use the small box or the flat envelope.
The envelope won't protect the model.
Then I'll take the small box.
I'll pack it in that.

items.why: I'll take the small box 后接 I'll pack it in that，确认盒子，信封已被否定。

lines.text: Hello, I'm checking the details for a lunch order. The first note says collection on the eighth, under the name Hales, with a total price of forty-six pounds.
I remember the order. Actually, collection needs to be on the tenth. The eighth is when our team returns to the office, and lunch isn't needed that day.
The tenth is possible. Would the eleventh be more convenient? There's a wider choice of dishes then.
No, please keep the tenth. Also, the name is Hale, without the final S. Hales was entered incorrectly on the first note.
I've corrected the name to Hale and confirmed the tenth. The total is forty-six pounds, or rather forty-three, because the delivery charge doesn't apply to collection.
Forty-three pounds is fine. We'll collect everything ourselves. Could the boxes be labelled separately?
Certainly. I'll label each box and leave them at the collection counter. The kitchen closes for cleaning on the eleventh, but that doesn't affect this order.
Thank you. The corrected date and price are both suitable.

items.stem: Which original detail is replaced by the correction beginning 'Actually'?
options: The team's return on the eighth
The kitchen closure on the eleventh
items.why: Actually, collection needs to be on the tenth 替换的是原来的领取日期 the eighth，即第一项。

items.stem: Why is £46 no longer the correct total?
options: The boxes no longer require labels.
The collection date has moved again.
The wider choice of dishes has been accepted.
items.why: because the delivery charge doesn't apply to collection 说明自取不收配送费，所以总价改了，即第三项。

items.stem: Which date is finally confirmed for collection?
options: The eighth, when the team returns
The tenth, as requested after correction
The eleventh, when more dishes are available
The eleventh, after the kitchen is cleaned
items.why: confirmed the tenth 给出最终日期，即第二项。eleventh 的提议没有被接受。

items.stem: Which name and amount should remain on the order?
items.why: corrected the name to Hale 与 Forty-three pounds is fine 分别确认姓名和金额。

lines.text: I'm calling about the community costume exchange. I left a note asking for a delivery of two storage trunks to the east entrance on Tuesday. Has that been arranged?
The note is here. Before confirming it, there's a change to the entrance. Please use the north entrance instead; the east entrance will be closed while the floor is repaired.
North entrance, understood. Could the delivery move to Wednesday? Tuesday is awkward for our volunteers.
Wednesday is unavailable, but Thursday is possible. The Tuesday slot is still free if keeping the original date would be easier.
Thursday will work. Please book that. The organisation name is Thread Circle, or rather, Thread Club. I used our former name by mistake.
I've recorded Thread Club and confirmed Thursday at the north entrance. The charge remains twenty pounds; changing the entrance doesn't add a fee.
That's agreed. We still need both trunks.
Both are included in the booking. The volunteers can phone the office on Wednesday to check the route, but the delivery will remain on Thursday.

items.why: use the north entrance instead 替换的是 east entrance，即第二项。
or rather 后的 Thread Club 替代刚说出的 Thread Circle，即第四项。

items.stem: Which delivery arrangement is finally valid?
items.why: confirmed Thursday at the north entrance 给出了日期和入口，即第一项。Wednesday 只是打电话核对路线的日子。

items.stem: What is the final charge for the booking?
options: More than £20 because the entrance changed
£20 for each of the two trunks
Less than £20 because the date changed
items.why: charge remains twenty pounds 和 doesn't add a fee 说明费用仍是 20 镑，换入口不加钱，即第三项。
